verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is a single help-center category title listing scheduled tasks (定时任务), which suggests time-based automatic triggering. The editor sidebar's generic mention of "automated tasks" is vague and does not describe rule-based triggers. missing for 10: documented user-defined trigger rules, event types beyond schedules (e.g. file, message or webhook events), how a rule maps to an action, any in-depth docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
